facades.name: south block front
facades.note: w02-195 (2024-09-20, 42.6 px/m): the crop holds the lower 12 m. Ground: 17 tall narrow blue-framed windows and doors east of the mall undercroft (four slits narrower than 0.3 m are pipes and not counted); storey 1 (5.5-7.2 m): 21 yellow-framed windows in groups of a pair and a single every 7.05 m. The balconies above 7.25 m and the undercroft's glass 10 m back are outside the band.
